# merge cancer, immune and CAF
```{r}
# add T cell labels to immune and update immune type for T cells
immune_with_cell_types = AddMetaData(object = immune_with_cell_types,
                                     metadata =t_cells_labled$t_cell_label,col.name = "t_cell_label")

immune_with_cell_types@meta.data = immune_with_cell_types@meta.data %>%
  mutate(immune_type =
           case_when(
             immune_type %in% c("Naive CD4+ T", "Effector CD8+ T", "CD8+ NKT-like") ~ t_cell_label,
             TRUE ~ immune_type
           )
  )
  


#remove unclear lum-myo cells
acc_cancer_cells_no_mid = subset(acc_cancer_cells,subset = cell_identity != "mid")


# merge cancer, immune and CAF
common_genes = rownames(acc_cancer_cells_no_mid) %>% intersect (rownames(immune_with_cell_types)) %>% intersect(rownames(acc_caf_cells))
acc_cancer_and_cd45 = merge(acc_cancer_cells_no_mid[common_genes,],immune_with_cell_types[common_genes,])
overlapping_cells = colnames(acc_cancer_cells_no_mid) %>% intersect(colnames(acc_caf_cells)) 
acc_cancer_immune_caf = merge(acc_cancer_and_cd45[common_genes,],acc_caf_cells[common_genes,] )

acc_cancer_immune_caf  = subset(acc_cancer_immune_caf,subset = tissue == "pri") # subset only primary tumors, metastatic tumors have different microenvironment and we want to avoid that confounding factor.
```

```{r}
metadata = FetchData(acc_cancer_immune_caf,vars = c("tissue","cell_identity","immune_type","t_cell_label"))

metadata  = metadata %>%  mutate(cell_type =
                                   if_else(
                                     condition = cell_identity == "immune",
                                     true = immune_type,
                                     false = cell_identity))


acc_cancer_immune_caf = AddMetaData(object = acc_cancer_immune_caf,metadata = metadata[,"cell_type",drop=F],col.name = "cell_type")
Idents(acc_cancer_immune_caf) <- acc_cancer_immune_caf@meta.data$cell_type

```

# plot function 

```{r}
make_dotplot <- function(dataet,cell_types_1, cell_types_2, threshold, patients, target_cell = NULL, plot = TRUE){
  filtered_results = data.frame()
  # for each patient, filter the results that pass the threshold 
  for (patient in names(dataet)){
    if (is.null(dataet[[patient]])){
      next()
    }
    patient_results = dataet[[patient]] %>%
    # show only interactions between immune cells and cancer cells
    dplyr::filter((source %in% cell_types_1 & target %in% cell_types_2) | 
          (source %in% cell_types_2 & target %in% cell_types_1)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(aggregate_rank <= threshold, ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(pair = paste0(source, "-", target)) %>%
    mutate (patient = patient)
    filtered_results = rbind(filtered_results, patient_results)
  }

  # calclaute mean "natmi.edge_specificity" and mean "sca.LRscore" of all patients for each ligand-receptor pair
  filtered_results = filtered_results %>%
    group_by(pair,ligand.complex, receptor.complex, source, target) %>%
  summarise(
    natmi.edge_specificity = mean(natmi.edge_specificity, na.rm = TRUE),
    sca.LRscore = mean(sca.LRscore, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_patients = n_distinct(patient),
  ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(desc(natmi.edge_specificity))
  
  filtered_results = filtered_results %>% filter(n_patients %in% patients)

  if (nrow(filtered_results) == 0){
    message("No interactions found for the specified patients and threshold.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  # Hierarchically cluster interactions using sca.LRscore across source-target pairs.
  # The resulting order is passed to liana_dotplot through the input row order.
  cluster_matrix = filtered_results %>%
    mutate(
      interaction = paste(ligand.complex, receptor.complex, sep = " -> "),
      pair = paste(source, target, sep = " - ")
    ) %>%
    group_by(interaction, pair) %>%
    summarise(sca.LRscore = mean(sca.LRscore, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = pair,
      values_from = sca.LRscore,
      values_fill = 0
    ) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("interaction") %>%
    as.matrix()

  interaction_order = rownames(cluster_matrix)
  if (nrow(cluster_matrix) > 1) {
    interaction_order = interaction_order[hclust(
      dist(cluster_matrix),
      method = "complete"
    )$order]
  }

  filtered_results = filtered_results %>%
    mutate(
      interaction = paste(ligand.complex, receptor.complex, sep = " -> "),
      interaction = factor(interaction, levels = interaction_order)
    ) %>%
    arrange(interaction)

  p = liana_dotplot(filtered_results,
              source_groups = unique(filtered_results$source),
                target_groups =  if (is.null(target_cell))  unique(filtered_results$target) else target_cell,
                specificity  = "n_patients")+  
              scale_radius(
                  range  = c(3, 9),  # מתחיל מגודל 3 (שערך 1 לא יהיה זעיר) ועולה עד 9
                  breaks = c(1, 2, 3, 4),   # מונע את ה-3.25, 3.50 וכו'
                )+
                  labs(size = "Number of patients")  +theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))+
                  ggtitle(paste0("Significant interactions (< ", threshold, ") in at least ", min(patients), " patients\nSource"))
  if (plot){
    print(p)
  }
  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
print_receptors_cor <- function(receptors, seurat, target_cell, pathway) {
  seurat = subset(seurat, idents =  target_cell)
  receptors_expression = FetchData(object = seurat, vars = c(receptors,pathway), slot = "data")
  cor_results = cor(receptors_expression, method = "pearson")
  # for clolumns, take only pathway
  cor_results = cor_results[,pathway,drop=F]
  p = ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(cor_results, name = "Correlation", 
                  col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("blue", "white", "red")),
                  show_row_names = TRUE, show_column_names = TRUE,
                  column_title = paste0("Correlation between receptors and ", pathway, " in ", target_cell, " cells"),
                  row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10),
                  column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10),
                  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Correlation", 
                                              title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"),
                                              labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10)))
  print(p)
  
}
```


# Functions for analyzing interactions and pathways
```{r}
# Split interaction labels into the ligand and receptor gene names.
extract_interaction_genes <- function(interaction_data) {
  interactions <- interaction_data |>
    dplyr::pull(interaction) |>
    as.character() |>
    unique()

  parsed <- strsplit(interactions, "-")
  list(
    ligands = parsed |> purrr::map_chr(1) |> stringr::str_trim() |> unique(),
    receptors = parsed |> purrr::map_chr(2) |> stringr::str_remove("^>\\s*") |> stringr::str_trim() |> unique()
  )
}

# Find significant pathways for each source and target cell pair.
analyze_interaction_pathways <- function(
  liana_results, origin_cells, target_cells, threshold, patients,
  seurat_object, ligand_target_matrix, pathways_by_cell,
  pathway_metadata, n_top_genes, expression_fraction = 0.10
) {
  results <- list()

  for (origin_cell in origin_cells) {
    for (target_cell in target_cells) {
      message("Analyzing interactions from ", origin_cell, " to ", target_cell)
      p_target <- make_dotplot(
        liana_results, origin_cell, target_cell, threshold,
        patients = patients, target_cell = target_cell, plot = FALSE
      )
      if (is.null(p_target)) next

      genes <- extract_interaction_genes(p_target$data)
      ligands <- intersect(genes$ligands, colnames(ligand_target_matrix))
      if (!length(ligands)) next

      # Use genes expressed in at least the requested fraction of receiver cells.
      receiver_cells <- Idents(seurat_object) == target_cell
      if (!any(receiver_cells)) next

      expression_fraction_by_gene <- GetAssayData(
        seurat_object, slot = "data"
      )[, receiver_cells, drop = FALSE] |>
        apply(1, function(x) mean(x > 0))
      expressed_genes <- expression_fraction_by_gene[
        expression_fraction_by_gene >= expression_fraction
      ] |>
        names()

      # Combine the target scores of all ligands by taking the highest score per gene.
      regulatory_scores <- ligand_target_matrix[, ligands, drop = FALSE] |>
        as.matrix() |>
        matrixStats::rowMaxs()
      names(regulatory_scores) <- rownames(ligand_target_matrix)
      ranked_genes <- sort(regulatory_scores[names(regulatory_scores) %in% expressed_genes], decreasing = TRUE)

      # Use the pathways assigned to this receiver cell type.
      pathway_names <- pathways_by_cell[[target_cell]]
      pathway_genes <- pathway_metadata[
        seq_len(min(n_top_genes, nrow(pathway_metadata))), pathway_names, drop = FALSE
      ] |>
        as.list()

      enrichment_plot <- hypeR_fgsea(
        signature = ranked_genes, genesets = pathway_genes,
        up_only = TRUE, nproc = 1
      ) |>
        hyp_dots(merge = FALSE, fdr = 0.2)

      # Keep only pathways passing the stricter reporting threshold.
      results[[paste0(origin_cell, "_to_", target_cell)]] <- enrichment_plot$data |>
        dplyr::filter(fdr < 0.05) |>
        dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(nes)) |>
        dplyr::transmute(pathway_name = label, nes, fdr, le_genes = le)
    }
  }

  # Remove cell pairs for which no result was returned.
  results <- purrr::compact(results)
  combined_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(results, .id = "interaction_pair")

  # Keep the downstream table valid when no pathways pass the FDR cutoff.
  if (!"pathway_name" %in% names(combined_results)) {
    combined_results <- tibble::tibble(
      interaction_pair = character(),
      pathway_name = character(),
      nes = numeric(),
      fdr = numeric(),
      le_genes = list()
    )
  }

  combined_results
}



```



```{r}
# Plot enriched pathways across all source-target cell pairs.
plot_all_sig_interactions <- function(
  interaction_data,
  title = "Significant interactions across all cell types"
) {
  required_columns <- c("interaction_pair", "pathway_name", "nes", "fdr")
  missing_columns <- base::setdiff(required_columns, names(interaction_data))
  if (length(missing_columns)) {
    stop("Missing columns: ", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "))
  }

  plot_data <- interaction_data |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      interaction_pair = factor(interaction_pair),
      pathway_name = as.character(pathway_name)
    )

  if (nrow(plot_data) > 1) {
    # Order pathways by similarity of their NES profiles across cell pairs.
    nes_matrix <- plot_data |>
      dplyr::select(pathway_name, interaction_pair, nes) |>
      tidyr::pivot_wider(
        names_from = interaction_pair,
        values_from = nes,
        values_fill = 0
      ) |>
      tibble::column_to_rownames("pathway_name") |>
      as.matrix()

    pathway_order <- rownames(nes_matrix)
    if (nrow(nes_matrix) > 1) {
      pathway_order <- pathway_order[hclust(dist(nes_matrix), method = "complete")$order]
    }
    plot_data$pathway_name <- factor(plot_data$pathway_name, levels = pathway_order)
  }

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(interaction_pair, pathway_name, size = nes, color = fdr)) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "red", high = "blue", oob = scales::squish) +
    labs(
      x = "Interaction pair", y = "Pathway name",
      size = "NES", color = "FDR", title = title
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
    )
}
```

# Go pathways

```{r}
#GO:0002253 activation of immune response
#GO:0002507 tolerance induction
#GO:0002682 regulation of immune system process
#GO:0019882 antigen processing and presentation
#GO:0031294 lymphocyte costimulation
#GO:0045321 leukocyte activation
all_children = get_child_nodes(c('GO:0002253',"GO:0002507","GO:0002682",
                             "GO:0019882","GO:0031294","GO:0045321"))
```


```{r}
all_children = all_children %>% filter(distance<=1)
```


```{r}
# get all genes from all children pathways
results <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Hs.eg.db, 
                                 keys=c(all_children$child_go_id),
                                 columns = c('SYMBOL'), keytype = 
                                   "GOALL")
#store in a list
go_immune = list()
for (geneset_id in results$GOALL %>% unique()) {
  name = all_children[all_children$child_go_id ==  geneset_id,"child_name"] %>% unique() %>% 
    gsub(pattern = " ", replacement = "_")
  genes = results %>% filter(GOALL == geneset_id) %>% pull(SYMBOL) %>% unique()
  if (any(is.na(genes)) | length(genes) < 5) { #if there are less than 5 genes or some empty, skip
    next
  }
   go_immune[[name]] <- genes
}

#remove any elements starts with "regulatgion_of" in the name
go_immune = go_immune[!grepl("^regulation_of", names(go_immune))]
```

```{r}
all_ligands = list()
all_significant_interactions = list()
for (origin_cell in c("Luminal", "Myo")){
  for (target_cell in c("CD4_T", "CD8_T", "gdT", "Treg")){
    message(paste0("Analyzing interactions from ", origin_cell, " to ", target_cell))
    # get plot for the target cell type
    p_target = make_dotplot(liana_result_CD45_lum_myo, origin_cell, target_cell, threshold, patients = patients, target_cell = target_cell, plot = FALSE) 
    if (is.null(p_target)) {
      message(paste0("No interactions found for target cell type: ", target_cell))
      next()
    }
    ligands = p_target$data %>%
    dplyr::pull(interaction) %>%
    as.character() %>%
    unique() %>% # collapse to same interactions with different source cell types
    strsplit("-") %>%
    map_chr(1) %>% # take first element of the split (the ligand)
    str_trim()   %>%
    unique() # get unique ligands


    if(length(ligands) == 0){
      message(paste0("No ligands found for target cell type: ", target_cell))
      next()
    }
    ligands <- ligands[ligands %in% colnames(ligand_target_matrix)] # filter ligands to only those present in the ligand-target matrix

    expressed_genes_receiver <- GetAssayData(acc_cancer_immune_caf, slot = "data") %>%
    .[, Idents(acc_cancer_immune_caf) == target_cell] %>%
    apply(1, function(x) sum(x > 0) / length(x)) %>%
    .[. >= 0.10] %>%
    names()
    all_ligands[[paste0(origin_cell, "_to_", target_cell)]] = ligands
    ligand_regulatory_scores <- ligand_target_matrix[, ligands] %>% as.data.frame()
    row_names <- rownames(ligand_regulatory_scores)
    combined_regulatory_scores <- rowMaxs(as.matrix(ligand_regulatory_scores))
    names(combined_regulatory_scores) <- row_names

    # 2. filter only for genes expressed in your T cell (background)
    combined_regulatory_scores <- combined_regulatory_scores[names(combined_regulatory_scores) %in% expressed_genes_receiver]

    # 3. sort the scores from highest to lowest (to fit GSEA)
    ranked_gene_list <- sort(combined_regulatory_scores, decreasing = TRUE)

    hyp_obj <-hypeR_fgsea(signature = ranked_gene_list,genesets = go_immune,up_only = F,nproc=1, max.size = 200)
    plt = hyp_dots(hyp_obj,merge = F,fdr = 0.2) 
    plt = plt[[1]] + ggtitle(paste0("GSEA for ", target_cell, " downstream targets of ligands from ", origin_cell))
    print(plt)

    sig_interactions = plt$data %>% filter(fdr < 0.05) %>% arrange(desc(nes)) %>% pull(nes)
    names(sig_interactions) = plt$data %>% filter(fdr < 0.05) %>% arrange(desc(nes)) %>% pull(label)
    all_significant_interactions[[paste0(origin_cell, "_to_", target_cell)]] = sig_interactions

  }

}
```
